program.name: Floor Hip Ladders
program.subject: Hips & adductors
program.blurb: Short hip sessions with no gear: an adductor ladder one day, a hip circuit the next.
program.about: Inner thighs and hip flexors on the floor, no equipment. One day is a ladder of adductor and glute reps, one of each, then two, then three, with hip-flexor work after; the other is a circuit of side-lying, frog and Copenhagen work. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III holds longer.
program.split: Adductor & flexor ladder / hip circuit, no gear
